en.headline: Family Style Food Fest brings chef-led outdoor dining to West Kowloon this weekend
en.dek: The two-day event at Art Park Great Lawn features visiting chefs including Eddie Huang and local talent, with food stalls, music and limited seating experiences.
body: The Family Style Food Fest is taking place this weekend at the Great Lawn of Art Park in the West Kowloon Cultural District, organised as the first independent large-scale outdoor food event linked to Complex Asia.

The festival runs on Saturday and Sunday, with participating chefs including Eddie Huang, Jason Oh of Seoul restaurant TAK, and local Michelin-starred chef David Lai. Visitors can find food stalls inspired by Korean street food, Hong Kong estate culture and other concepts, alongside music and demonstration areas.

A limited Family Table long-table seating arrangement is available, with some places allocated through a bidding process. Organisers have published ticket options through several platforms, including standard day tickets and packages that include food credits.
The event is open to the public with advance ticketing recommended for certain experiences. Details on hours and remaining places are listed by the organisers.

zh.headline: Family Style Food Fest本周末西九藝術公園舉行戶外美食節
zh.dek: 為期兩天的活動邀請Eddie Huang等主廚參與，設有美食攤檔、音樂及限量長桌體驗。
body: Family Style Food Fest本周末於西九文化區藝術公園大草坪舉行，是Complex Asia相關的首個獨立大型戶外美食活動。
活動周六及周日進行，參與主廚包括Eddie Huang、首爾TAK餐廳的Jason Oh，以及本地米芝蓮一星主廚David Lai。場內有韓國街頭風味、港式屋邨概念等美食攤檔，並設音樂及示範區域。
另有限量Family Table長桌座位，部分席位以競投形式分配。主辦方透過多個平台發售普通門票及含餐飲額度的套票。
活動向公眾開放，部分體驗建議預先購票。開放時間及剩餘名額詳情以主辦方公布為準。
